# Vendored: CMS web theme

`cambridge-tokens.css` is the framework-agnostic build of
[cms-cambridge/cms-web-theme](https://github.com/cms-cambridge/cms-web-theme), copied unchanged from commit `07a0541`
(MIT, see `cms-web-theme-LICENSE`). It supplies the `--cam-*` tokens and the `.cam-*` components this app uses.

To update it, copy the new `css/cambridge-tokens.css` over this one and check the app in the browser. Do not edit it here:
the app's own rules live in `../style.css`, and the typefaces the theme asks for are self-hosted in `../fonts.css`.
